scientific_integrity: All finite computations are supplementary to the all-depth matrix proof. A normal limit follows from explicitly evaluated primitive finite-state spectral data; no external verification claimed.
scientific_limitations: Dyadic blocks, prime 2 and binomial family only; earlier general binomial-valuation distribution work may contain related specializations; no full inspection of Barat–Grabner 2001.
title: Exact valuation spectrum of \(\binom{3n}{n}\) on dyadic blocks
